caseName: City of New York v. Garrison
caseNameFull: City of New York v. Lindley M. Garrison, as Receiver, etc.
attorneys: Mr. Charles P. Howland, for appellees, in support of the motion. Mr. George P. Nicholson and Mr. William G. Fallen, for appellants, in opposition to the motion.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of Heike v. United States, 217 U. S. 423, 429; Rexford v. Brunswick-Balke Collender Co., 228 U. S. 339, 346; Collins v. Miller, 252 U. S. 364, 365; Oneida Navigation Corporation v. Job & Co., 252 U. S. 521, 522.
